observation.happening: A modal dialog titled「新しい録音」is open over the dimmed Home dashboard, letting the user configure a new recording (microphone, system audio toggle, template, save location, project) before starting.
observation.most_important: The primary filled button「録音を始める」at the bottom-right of the modal, paired with the secondary text button「やめる」.
observation.next_action: Adjust the dropdowns/toggle, then click 録音を始める to start recording, or やめる to cancel.
anomalies: Background list item text "Product Wee" is truncated right at the modal's edge with no ellipsis, an artifact of the dimmed backdrop rather than the dialog itself

observation.happening: A slim dark floating control bar shows an active/starting Google Meet recording at 00:00 with a row of action icons.
observation.most_important: The red stop button at the far right and the 00:00 elapsed timer next to the recording indicator.
observation.next_action: Click メモ, 字幕, or Ask Astra, or use the eye/pause/stop icon-only controls.
anomalies: Some controls carry a text label (メモ, 字幕, Ask Astra) while others in the same row (eye, pause, stop) are icon-only with no label, so their function is not equally legible at a glance

concerns.what: Mixed labeling: three controls have text+icon, three have icon only, within one small toolbar
concerns.where: Right half of the bar, the eye / pause / stop icons vs. メモ / 字幕 / Ask Astra

visible_text: この会議について聞く

observation.happening: A live meeting recording/transcription screen: a floating control bar shows elapsed time 04:21, the right panel streams a live transcript, and the left panel is meant to hold auto-extracted meeting notes.
observation.most_important: The recording is already 4+ minutes in and the transcript contains what reads like a decision ("それでは9月12日に出しましょう"), but the left panel's 決まったこと (Decisions) and やること (To-dos) sections still show placeholder "待っています..." text.
observation.next_action: Pause/stop the recording, switch to 翻訳 or 字幕 tabs, or type a question in the bottom input box.
anomalies: Large empty white space fills most of the left panel below the two placeholder lines
Left panel title is generic "会議" rather than a real meeting name, even though transcript content already exists

concerns.what: Left summary panel is mostly blank whitespace under two placeholder lines while the meeting is already well underway with substantive transcript content
concerns.where: Left column below 「やることを待っています...」

concerns.what: Decisions/to-dos still read as "waiting" even though the visible transcript already contains a decision-like statement, so it's unclear if extraction is stalled or simply behind
concerns.where: 「決まったこと」and「やること」sections vs. the 04:18 transcript line

visible_text: この Mac の中だけで動きます

observation.happening: An Apps/Plugins settings list shows ten installed assistant plugins, each with an icon, name, version, a green checkmark badge, and a row of permission-scope tags.
observation.most_important: The permission tags under each plugin (e.g. calendar.read/write, email.read/draft/modify, microphone.capture) which describe what each plugin is allowed to do.
observation.next_action: Scroll for more plugins, switch to the Connectors tab, or click a card to inspect/change its permissions.
anomalies: Every plugin, including ones named after distinct real-world services (Google Calendar, Gmail, Sales CRM, EHR Assist), is attributed to the identical author/version "astra · 0.1.0"
No visible toggle or disable control on any card — only a static green checkmark, so there's no evident way to turn a plugin off from this screen

concerns.what: Distinctly-branded integrations (Gmail, Google Calendar, Sales CRM) all show the same generic "astra · 0.1.0" author/version, giving no indication of who actually built or vouches for each integration
A green checkmark badge is the only status indicator on each card, with no visible enable/disable toggle
concerns.where: Top-right badge on each plugin card
